data.name: Primary Efficacy Objective
data.text: To demonstrate that 3 mg LY900018 is non-inferior to 1 mg IMG for the proportion of patients achieving treatment success from insulin-induced hypoglycemia using a non-inferiority margin of 10%

data.name: Secondary Safety and Tolerability Objective
data.text: To compare the safety and tolerability of 3 mg LY900018 with 1 mg IMG

data.name: Secondary Pharmacokinetic Objective
data.text: To characterize the PK profile of 3 mg LY900018 compared to 1 mg IMG

data.name: Secondary Pharmacodynamic Objective
data.text: To characterize the PD profile of 3 mg LY900018 compared to 1 mg IMG

data.name: Primary Efficacy Endpoint
data.text: The proportion of patients achieving treatment success defined as either an increase in PG to >70 mg/dL or an increase of >20 mg/dL from nadir within 30 minutes after administration of glucagon. The nadir is defined as the minimum PG value at the time of or within 10 minutes following glucagon administration.

data.name: Secondary Safety and Tolerability Endpoint
data.text: SAE, TEAEs (including gastrointestinal, nasal, and non-nasal AEs), vital signs

data.name: Secondary Pharmacokinetic Endpoint
data.text: PK parameters include AUC, Cmax, Tmax

data.name: Secondary Pharmacodynamic Endpoint
data.text: PD parameters include BGmax and Tmax

data.name: Primary Efficacy Estimand - Non-inferiority of Nasal Glucagon vs Intramuscular Glucagon
data.populationSummary: Japanese patients with type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) or type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) who are eligible for insulin-induced hypoglycemia treatment, enrolled in a 2-period crossover design with at least 66 completers (at least 30 patients with T1DM and 30 patients with T2DM) (Intent-to-Treat (ITT) Population - all randomized patients completing both periods with evaluable primary outcome) Summary measure: Difference in proportions (percentage of patients achieving treatment success: IMG minus LY900018) with a 2-sided 95% confidence interval based on the 1-sample mean of paired differences; non-inferiority declared if upper limit of 95% CI is less than the non-inferiority margin of 10%.

intercurrentEvents.name: Study treatment discontinuation before endpoint assessment
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient discontinues study treatment or withdraws from the study before completing both treatment periods with an evaluable primary outcome within 30 minutes post-glucagon administration

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of additional treatments to increase plasma glucose
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient receives additional treatments (e.g., intravenous glucose, additional glucagon) to increase plasma glucose within 30 minutes after glucagon administration, which is incorporated into the definition of treatment failure (composite outcome)

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to achieve adequate insulin-induced hypoglycemia
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient does not achieve the required hypoglycemic nadir (minimum PG at time of or within 10 minutes following glucagon administration) necessary for a valid treatment period assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Patient replacement due to non-evaluable primary outcome
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient discontinues before completion of both periods with evaluable primary outcome and is replaced; replaced patients are excluded from the primary analysis population

data.treatment: 3 mg LY900018 (nasal glucagon, single dose, nasal administration by study site personnel) compared to 1 mg IMG (GlucaGen, Novo Nordisk A/S, single dose, intramuscular injection by study site personnel)
data.analysisPopulation: Intent-to-Treat (ITT) Population - all randomized patients completing both periods with evaluable primary outcome
data.variableOfInterest: The proportion of patients achieving treatment success defined as either an increase in plasma glucose (PG) to ≥70 mg/dL or an increase of ≥20 mg/dL from nadir within 30 minutes after administration of glucagon, without the patient receiving additional treatments to increase PG
data.summaryMeasure: Difference in proportions (percentage of patients achieving treatment success: IMG minus LY900018) with a 2-sided 95% confidence interval based on the 1-sample mean of paired differences; non-inferiority declared if upper limit of 95% CI is less than the non-inferiority margin of 10%

data.name: Secondary Safety and Tolerability Estimand
data.populationSummary: Japanese patients with T1DM or T2DM who received at least one dose of study treatment (LY900018 or IMG) in the crossover study (Safety Population - all patients who received at least one dose of study treatment) Summary measure: Frequency and percentage of patients experiencing SAEs and TEAEs by system organ class and preferred term; descriptive statistics for vital signs; comparison between treatment groups.

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation due to adverse event
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient discontinues study treatment due to an adverse event; all adverse events occurring after study drug administration are captured regardless of treatment completion status

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of concomitant medications for adverse event management
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient receives concomitant medications to manage treatment-emergent adverse events; all TEAEs are recorded regardless of concomitant medication use

data.treatment: 3 mg LY900018 (nasal glucagon, single dose, nasal administration) compared to 1 mg IMG (GlucaGen, single dose, intramuscular injection)
data.analysisPopulation: Safety Population - all patients who received at least one dose of study treatment
data.variableOfInterest: Incidence and nature of serious adverse events (SAEs), treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) including gastrointestinal, nasal, and non-nasal adverse events, and changes in vital signs following single-dose administration
data.summaryMeasure: Frequency and percentage of patients experiencing SAEs and TEAEs by system organ class and preferred term; descriptive statistics for vital signs; comparison between treatment groups

data.name: Secondary Pharmacokinetic Estimand
data.populationSummary: Japanese patients with T1DM or T2DM who received at least one dose of study treatment and have evaluable pharmacokinetic samples in the crossover study (Pharmacokinetic (PK) Population - all patients who received at least one dose of study treatment with at least one evaluable PK sample) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics (geometric mean, coefficient of variation) for AUC and Cmax; median and range for Tmax; comparison between LY900018 and IMG treatment groups within the crossover design.

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing or non-evaluable PK samples
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient has missing or non-evaluable pharmacokinetic blood samples due to sampling errors, hemolysis, or other technical issues, resulting in incomplete PK profiles

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation before PK sampling completion
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient discontinues study participation before all scheduled PK blood samples are collected; only data collected while on treatment are included in PK analysis

data.treatment: 3 mg LY900018 (nasal glucagon, single dose, nasal administration) compared to 1 mg IMG (GlucaGen, single dose, intramuscular injection)
data.analysisPopulation: Pharmacokinetic (PK) Population - all patients who received at least one dose of study treatment with at least one evaluable PK sample
data.variableOfInterest: Pharmacokinetic parameters including area under the concentration-time curve (AUC), maximum observed plasma concentration (Cmax), and time to maximum concentration (Tmax) following single-dose administration of glucagon
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive statistics (geometric mean, coefficient of variation) for AUC and Cmax; median and range for Tmax; comparison between LY900018 and IMG treatment groups within the crossover design

data.name: Secondary Pharmacodynamic Estimand
data.populationSummary: Japanese patients with T1DM or T2DM who received at least one dose of study treatment and have evaluable pharmacodynamic assessments in the crossover study (Pharmacodynamic (PD) Population - all patients who received at least one dose of study treatment with at least one evaluable PD measurement) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics (mean, standard deviation, median, range) for BGmax; median and range for Tmax of plasma glucose; comparison between LY900018 and IMG treatment groups within the crossover design.

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of additional treatments to increase plasma glucose affecting PD assessment
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient receives additional treatments (e.g., intravenous glucose) to increase plasma glucose during the assessment window, confounding the pharmacodynamic response attributable to study glucagon alone

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing or non-evaluable plasma glucose measurements
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient has missing or non-evaluable plasma glucose measurements during the post-dose assessment period, resulting in inability to determine BGmax or Tmax

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to achieve adequate insulin-induced hypoglycemia nadir
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient does not achieve the required hypoglycemic nadir, rendering the pharmacodynamic assessment of glucagon response non-interpretable for that period

data.treatment: 3 mg LY900018 (nasal glucagon, single dose, nasal administration) compared to 1 mg IMG (GlucaGen, single dose, intramuscular injection)
data.analysisPopulation: Pharmacodynamic (PD) Population - all patients who received at least one dose of study treatment with at least one evaluable PD measurement
data.variableOfInterest: Pharmacodynamic parameters including maximal plasma glucose concentration (BGmax) and time to maximal plasma glucose concentration (Tmax) following single-dose administration of glucagon during insulin-induced hypoglycemia
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive statistics (mean, standard deviation, median, range) for BGmax; median and range for Tmax of plasma glucose; comparison between LY900018 and IMG treatment groups within the crossover design
